node.statement: Conclusion. Since the assumption of such a P leads to a contradiction for every finite I, every A ∈ [4,6], and every tau ∈ (0, 1/256] with t = tau^2, a = tau/(1+tau), there is no rank-three exact signed idempotent P (P²=P, P·1=1, rank P = 3) with row negative masses nu_i ≤ t exhibiting the specified five-actor display, top-row masses, planar coordinatization, and slab/hull confinement of nonactor support fibers. This is exactly the bounded-slab starvation completion obstruction (K-free).
